verdict.rationale: An online company-incorporation service could plausibly offer AI-generated guidance or suggestions, so the axis applies. However, the evidence describes no AI insights or suggestions feature. The automatic generation of the pact document from form data is template-based document assembly, not AI-generated insights, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
